designVerdict: PRODUCTION REMEDIATION PROGRAM DESIGNED — READY FOR CONTROLLED EXECUTION

slices.name: Environment Decision and Resource Allocation
slices.objective: Approve isolated Local/Preview/Staging/Production boundaries, resource ownership, regions, billing and data classification.
plannedExternalConfiguration: Reserve two new Firebase/GCP projects for Preview and Staging
Decide Production bucket in-place versus replacement
writeChanges: Documentation only in R1A; project creation occurs only in a separately approved execution change
preconditions: Roles available for Security, Cloud, Firebase and Deployment approval
tests: No shared project/bucket/queue/secret/runtime identity across Preview, Staging and Production
slices.rollback: Documentation rollback only; no resource is created by this slice.
slices.exitCriterion: All four environments have approved boundaries, accountable roles, regions, billing and rollback targets.
slices.stopCondition: Any proposal shares Production data or credentials with Preview/Staging.

slices.name: Explicit Targeting and Promotion Guardrails
slices.objective: Remove implicit default targeting and bind CI/Vercel configuration to approved environments.
plannedExternalConfiguration: Bind Vercel Preview to Preview project variables
Create isolated Staging Vercel project or approved equivalent
readOnlyChanges: Read aliases, workflow permissions and Vercel project metadata
writeChanges: Configure protected environment variables by name/target
tests: Preview cannot resolve Production project or bucket
slices.rollback: Revert repository targeting changes while keeping deployments frozen; never fall back to an implicit default deploy.
slices.exitCriterion: Every deploy path requires explicit project/environment and protected approval.
slices.stopCondition: A workflow can deploy with only the default alias or a Preview branch can access Production config.

slices.name: Administrative Trust Root Migration
slices.objective: Move administrative and tenant authority mutations from clients to audited Admin SDK commands using the canonical principal resolver.
readOnlyChanges: Static inventory of writers and principal-resolution paths
writeChanges: Add internal Admin SDK mutation ports
Migrate client callers away from direct authority writes
risks: Public callable accidentally gains administrative power
preconditions: Authority owner and Security approver assigned
slices.rollback: Revert application callers to the previous backend-compatible release; do not restore client writes to authority collections.
slices.entryCriterion: R1A complete and current client writers inventoried.
slices.exitCriterion: Every legitimate authority mutation has one backend-owned, audited path and clients no longer require direct writes.
slices.stopCondition: A client or public unauthenticated surface remains an authority writer.
slices.suggestedCommit: feat(authority): migrate administrative trust root writes

slices.name: Firestore and Storage Rules Closure
slices.objective: Deny client writes to authority and server-owned data while preserving only explicitly authorized reads and business writes.
plannedExternalConfiguration: Deploy exact reviewed ruleset to Production only after compatibility gate
readOnlyChanges: Retrieve deployed Rules release/hash before write
preconditions: Rollback target is already deny-write safe
slices.rollback: Rollback application first; Rules may roll back only to a previously certified deny-write ruleset.
slices.entryCriterion: No legitimate client depends on direct authority/server-owned writes.
slices.exitCriterion: Emulator and deployed Staging/Production hashes prove backend-only ownership.
slices.stopCondition: Rules API remains unreadable, a client writer remains, or rollback requires reopening authority writes.
slices.suggestedCommit: fix(rules): close administrative and discovery trust roots

slices.name: Workload Identities and Workload Identity Federation
slices.objective: Create dedicated runtime, deployer and auditor identities per environment without persistent keys.
plannedExternalConfiguration: Dedicated runtime SAs per trust boundary/environment
slices.rollback: Remove new impersonation bindings and retain prior runtime until R3B cutover is verified.
slices.entryCriterion: Environment IDs and deploy authorities are approved.
slices.exitCriterion: All target workloads have dedicated identities and CI authenticates without key material.
slices.stopCondition: Any SA needs Editor/Owner, accepts broad WIF subjects, or has a user-managed key.
slices.suggestedCommit: docs(iam): define workload identities and wif deployment

slices.name: Privilege and Secret Access Cutover
slices.objective: Bind workloads/secrets to dedicated identities and remove legacy Editor, permanent human privilege and unmanaged keys safely.
readOnlyChanges: Read effective IAM, secret versions/consumers and service-level invokers
writeChanges: Remove broad roles/old bindings/keys only after read-back
preconditions: R2A authority path uses target identities
slices.rollback: Restore only the specific prior workload binding for the failing service; never restore project Editor as blanket rollback.
slices.entryCriterion: Dedicated identities exist and negative permissions are certified in Staging.
slices.exitCriterion: Default compute is not a scoped runtime/secret accessor, broad Editor is removed, human elevation is time-bound and key count is zero.
slices.stopCondition: Last recoverable admin would be removed, a service needs project-wide privilege, or key inventory is unavailable.
slices.suggestedCommit: docs(iam): record least privilege cutover evidence

slices.name: Staging Backend Alignment
slices.objective: Deploy the certified P1-P8 backend artifact to isolated Staging with all public/costly surfaces disabled.
plannedExternalConfiguration: Set flags OFF, quotas 0 and queue PAUSED
slices.rollback: Keep switches OFF/queue paused and return Staging traffic to the previous certified revision.
slices.exitCriterion: Staging runs P1-P8 from the expected artifact under dedicated identities with zero enabled public traffic.
slices.stopCondition: Any R1-R3 control is open or deployment enables a surface by default.

slices.name: App Check Enforcement and Debug Token Closure
slices.objective: Configure approved providers/enforcement, eliminate Production debug bypass and create failure observability.
plannedExternalConfiguration: Enable enforcement in Staging then Production
expectedCommands: Approved App Check control-plane read/write procedure frozen in the slice runbook
readOnlyChanges: List apps/providers/enforcement/debug-token counts and valid/invalid/missing metrics
slices.rollback: Disable traffic with containment before any temporary enforcement rollback; never reintroduce an unowned Production debug token.
slices.entryCriterion: R4A closed and app inventory isolated per environment.
slices.exitCriterion: Approved provider/enforcement is verified on all surfaces and Production debug-token count is zero.
slices.stopCondition: Provider ownership is unknown, legitimate Staging clients cannot initialize, or enforcement cannot be read back.

slices.name: Firestore TTL, Indexes and Recovery
slices.objective: Materialize idempotency TTL, bounded query indexes and approved Firestore recovery controls.
expectedCommands: gcloud firestore fields ttls update expiresAt --collection-group=discovery_intake_idempotency --enable-ttl --project=<STAGING_PROJECT_ID>
slices.rollback: Contain new writes, disable cleanup and preserve backups/evidence; disabling TTL does not restore deleted documents.
slices.entryCriterion: R4A/R2B closed and Privacy/Platform retention decision approved.
slices.exitCriterion: TTL/indexes/recovery controls are active and observable in Staging and Production with approved evidence.
slices.stopCondition: No backup/evidence decision, unexpected deletes, index errors, or cleanup can touch active records.
slices.suggestedCommit: feat(firestore): version ttl indexes and recovery controls

slices.name: Storage and Signed URL Hardening
slices.objective: Enforce bucket isolation/access/lifecycle and least-privilege five-minute signed URL grants.
writeChanges: Migrate data only via a separate approved plan if replacement chosen
tests: Five-minute URL TTL with fake signer
slices.rollback: Disable document download, revoke signer, preserve data and roll application back; bucket migrations use their own reversible copy plan.
slices.entryCriterion: R3B identities and R4A Staging backend are ready.
slices.exitCriterion: Each environment has an isolated non-public bucket, approved lifecycle and least-privilege signer with effective five-minute TTL.
slices.stopCondition: Any public ACL, shared bucket, unbounded signer or retention conflict appears.

slices.name: Functions Runtime Quotas
slices.objective: Apply approved maxInstances, concurrency, timeout and memory per public/cost surface.
plannedExternalConfiguration: Deploy per-function runtime limits Staging then Production
readOnlyChanges: Compare deployed ServiceConfig to approved matrix
writeChanges: Version options and deploy approved limits
slices.rollback: Switch affected surface OFF, restore last approved bounded limit and do not use platform defaults.
slices.entryCriterion: R4A deployed with minimum rollout limits.
slices.exitCriterion: Every scoped function exactly matches an approved explicit limit set.
slices.stopCondition: A limit lacks owner approval, is absent/defaulted, or exceeds the security ceiling.

slices.name: Cloud Tasks and Notification Gateway
slices.objective: Bound notification dispatch, authenticate one caller/audience and operationalize replay/backlog recovery.
slices.rollback: Pause queue, switch fan-out OFF and revert gateway/function revision while preserving tasks/audit for controlled recovery.
slices.exitCriterion: Queue and gateway have bounded throughput, one trusted caller/audience, replay safety and recovery evidence.
slices.stopCondition: Queue can dispatch before auth/containment, fan-out exceeds one recipient, or backlog has no recoverable strategy.
slices.suggestedCommit: fix(notifications): bound task dispatch and gateway trust

slices.name: Kill Switches and Emergency Policy
slices.objective: Provision an immutable, environment-scoped, audited containment policy with expiry and rollback.
plannedExternalConfiguration: Activate Production deny-all policy after two-role approval
readOnlyChanges: Read active pointer, policy, expiry, quotas, audit and rollback metadata
slices.rollback: Use only the validated rollback pointer; if invalid, keep current policy deny-all and stop.
slices.entryCriterion: Runtime code and ordinary limits are deployed in Staging.
slices.exitCriterion: Staging rollback is proven and Production has an active unexpired deny-all policy with audit.
slices.stopCondition: Tool permits public/direct writes, policy environment mismatches, audit is non-atomic, or rollback is invalid.
slices.suggestedCommit: feat(containment): add trusted policy rollout tooling

slices.name: Abuse Observability and P0 Alerts
slices.objective: Create structured metrics, dashboards and routed alerts for security, reliability, lifecycle and cost signals.
readOnlyChanges: Metric/log schema validation without payload output
writeChanges: Version/apply metrics, dashboards, alerts and routing
preconditions: Runbook stubs and owner roles assigned
slices.rollback: Disable noisy policy while preserving metric/audit data; containment remains active and a manual watch is assigned.
slices.exitCriterion: Required P0 alerts and dashboards exist, are routed, tested and linked to owners/runbooks.
slices.stopCondition: An alert exposes sensitive data, has no owner/runbook, or routing test fails.
slices.suggestedCommit: ops(observability): define public intake security alerts

slices.name: Budgets and Provider Cost Controls
slices.objective: Assign thresholds, escalation and containment for GCP, Gemini, Vercel, Storage, Tasks and notifications.
expectedCommands: Provider-specific metadata-only usage/budget read-back commands frozen in the slice
readOnlyChanges: Read budget names, thresholds, owners and routing without secret/spend payloads beyond approved metadata
slices.rollback: Restore last approved threshold/routing; never remove all cost monitoring during rollback.
slices.entryCriterion: R9A alerting and routing are operational.
slices.exitCriterion: Every provider has an owner, threshold, escalation and containment decision with read-back evidence.
slices.stopCondition: Budget access is unavailable, no owner accepts escalation, or a costly provider lacks containment.

slices.name: Incident Response, Rollback and Break-Glass
slices.objective: Create and exercise thirteen operational runbooks with time-bound privilege and verified rollback.
plannedExternalConfiguration: Time-bound break-glass roles and approval workflow are configured by a separate IAM change after tabletop approval
expectedCommands: Read-only commands from each control runbook
No break-glass activation command before its approved tabletop
readOnlyChanges: Validate owners, routing, evidence and current config references
writeChanges: Documentation and tabletop records; later IAM break-glass config only under separate approval
slices.rollback: Revoke exercise access, close temporary channels and preserve tabletop evidence; technical controls remain fail-closed.
slices.entryCriterion: R5-R9 complete and alert routing operational.
slices.exitCriterion: All runbooks are approved, assigned and exercised; rollback and break-glass succeed outside Production.
slices.stopCondition: A runbook lacks owner/escalation, requires personal standing access, or an exercise cannot restore safe state.
slices.suggestedCommit: docs(runbooks): add production incident response set

slices.name: Controlled Production Backend Promotion
slices.objective: Promote the exact Staging-certified P1-P8 artifact to Production with traffic and costly surfaces disabled.
plannedExternalConfiguration: Keep switches OFF, quotas 0 and queue PAUSED
readOnlyChanges: Pre/post deployment config and provenance read-back
writeChanges: Production Functions deployment only; no traffic enablement
tests: Missing/invalid App Check denial without effects
slices.rollback: Switches OFF, queue PAUSED and revision rollback to prior certified artifact; preserve safe Rules and audit data.
slices.entryCriterion: G8 production change approval and all R5-R10 controls closed.
slices.exitCriterion: Production backend matches the certified artifact under safe disabled configuration.
slices.stopCondition: Any P0/P1 gate is open, artifact differs, config read-back fails, or a surface becomes enabled.
slices.suggestedCommit: chore(release): record controlled production backend promotion

slices.name: Read-Only P9 Revalidation
slices.objective: Repeat P9 metadata verification and prove closure of every mapped control without writes or productive traffic.
expectedCommands: P9 read-only command catalog with explicit projects
readOnlyChanges: All P9 remote metadata, hashes, IAM, App Check, lifecycle, queues, monitoring, budgets and Vercel config
tests: All P9 controls assigned and re-read
slices.rollback: Documentation rollback only; no external state changes are allowed.
slices.entryCriterion: Production artifact/config deployed under safe disabled state.
slices.exitCriterion: All P0 closed, P1 closed or formally excepted with owner/expiry, and no blocking unknown remains.
slices.stopCondition: Any secret/PII appears, write occurs, project is ambiguous, access cannot verify a P0, or any P0 remains.
slices.suggestedCommit: docs(security): revalidate production configuration after remediation

slices.name: Final Production Readiness Certification
slices.objective: Perform independent final review of code, effective configuration, ownership, rollback and evidence.
readOnlyChanges: Review R1-R11 evidence and effective-state read-backs
preconditions: Independent reviewer has no implementation conflict
slices.rollback: Withdraw the readiness recommendation if evidence expires or drift appears; return to the owning remediation slice.
slices.entryCriterion: R11 reports no P0 and no blocking unknown.
slices.exitCriterion: Independent decision recorded with residual risks and any separate operational next step.
slices.stopCondition: Reviewer is not independent, evidence is stale, or any gate/owner/rollback is missing.
slices.suggestedCommit: docs(security): record final production readiness certification
